title: Kummer-normalized cohomological purity for a smooth divisor
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, $\ell$ a prime invertible in $k$, $n\geq1$, and $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$. Let $X$ be a separated scheme [def-weil-proper-morphism] of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] that is smooth over $k$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and let $i:D\hookrightarrow X$ be an effective Cartier divisor [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal] that is also smooth over $k$. Use ordinary small-etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], roots-of-unity twists [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], and $H_D^q(X,-)=H^q(R\Gamma_D(X,-))$ [def-pur-etale-derived-supported-sections]. Let $c_{D,\Lambda}:Ri_*\Lambda_D\to\Lambda_X(1)[2]$ be the positive supported Kummer map of [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer]. The maps induced by this supported morphism are isomorphisms
$$\operatorname{pur}_{D}^{q,t}:H^{q-2}(D,\Lambda(t-1))\xrightarrow{\sim}H_D^q(X,\Lambda(t))\qquad(q,t\in\mathbf Z).$$
The composite with forgetting support is the Gysin map $i_*:H^{q-2}(D,\Lambda(t-1))\to H^q(X,\Lambda(t))$. Its normalization is $i_*(1)=+c_1(\mathcal O_X(D))$, where $c_1$ is the Kummer boundary. There is no assumption that $k$ is algebraic over a finite field.
